product.summary: Core is a screenless 'brain in a box' personal computer dedicated to AI agents. Accessed via a smartphone app, priced at $3,499.
product.problem_statement: Traditional PCs are general-purpose devices waiting for commands. Cloud AI requires entrusting personal data to external companies, and running AI models directly on existing hardware involves complex setup and poor performance.
product.solution: Designed to aggregate personal data—desktop files, apps, smart home devices—into one piece of hardware so AI agents run continuously. Models and personal memory run locally with encrypted data, and users can directly adjust the agent's autonomy level.
key_features: Pre-installed Qwen-3.8-Next, Qwen-3.8-27B, Gemma-4-31B models; additional models can be installed from Hugging Face
OTA updates for automatic transition to latest model generations (Tesla-style)
Built-in proprietary software layer, browser, and file system
Dedicated firewall monitoring agent's external network requests
Continuously processes data to provide notifications without prompts (e.g., predicting cold symptoms using heart rate, computer usage history, and seasonal information)
product.tech_stack_or_innovation: Integrated design optimizing hardware, agent OS, and security firewall for continuous AI agent operation. All source code, logic, and model weights are stored on the device, ensuring the device continues working even if Ghost shuts down.
product.target_customer: Tech enthusiasts and privacy-conscious users who want AI agents without handing over personal data to external parties. Early adopters willing to pay $3,499 for a high-end desktop.
product.business_model: Direct hardware sales. Pre-orders began October 5, with first shipments in the last week of October. Potential future expansion into agent ecosystem and peripheral lineup.

product.summary: A mechanical delivery platform that enables oral administration of biologic drugs that require injection, using standard size 0 or 00 capsules. When the capsule is swallowed, the device attaches to the stomach lining and releases the drug directly into the tissue.
product.problem_statement: Many modern biologics are injectable, requiring hospital visits and facing issues with cold chain distribution, needle phobia, and patient compliance. Conventional oral drug development has been limited due to the intestinal absorption barrier.
product.solution: BIONDD mechanically delivers the drug to the gastric mucosal wall and has demonstrated bioavailability similar to subcutaneous injection in preclinical studies. Patients simply swallow a capsule.
key_features: Miniature device that fits into standard size 0 and 00 capsules.
Attaches to the gastric mucosal wall via a spring mechanism after capsule dissolution.
Made of biodegradable materials and is excreted after passing through the gastrointestinal tract.
Injection molding-based production enables mass manufacturing and cost reduction.
Preclinical demonstration of bioavailability comparable to subcutaneous injection.
product.tech_stack_or_innovation: The core innovation is the implementation of a mechanical device via injection molding that injects the drug directly into the gastric mucosal wall without the need for absorption enhancers.
product.target_customer: Pharmaceutical companies with injectable biologic drugs. The company has collaborations with Eli Lilly and CSL Behring.
product.business_model: The structure is estimated to combine co-development and licensing agreements with pharmaceutical companies, along with non-dilutive partnership funding.

direct_competitors.comparison: Develops the RaniPill, a robotic capsule that injects drugs into the intestine. Biograil focuses on gastric mucosal attachment and injection, with a strength in injection molding-based manufacturing.
Launched Rybelsus, an oral GLP-1 based on absorption enhancers. Biograil differs by using mechanical delivery instead of absorption enhancers.

competitive_landscape.key_differentiator: An absorption enhancer-free approach that directly attaches to the gastric mucosal wall to inject the drug, and an injection molding-based mass production design.
competitive_landscape.moat: Patents and know-how in mechanical oral delivery, a team with experience developing FDA-approved injection-molded oral tablets, and investments and partnerships from global pharmaceutical companies such as Eli Lilly.
competitive_landscape.competitive_position_summary: Although still in the preclinical stage, the company has secured funding, a network of pharmaceutical companies, and manufacturing know-how, making it a notable contender alongside Rani Therapeutics in the race for oral biologic drug delivery.

product.summary: A digital therapeutic solution that measures and analyzes electromyography (EMG) signals via wearable sensors and AI to assist in diagnosing musculoskeletal conditions, and provides personalized exercise programs and functional electrical stimulation (FES) therapy.
product.problem_statement: Patients with neuromuscular and musculoskeletal conditions (e.g., stroke, Parkinson's, sarcopenia) require continuous rehabilitation after discharge, but limited hospital access and subjective assessment methods (physician visual inspection) often lead to interrupted or inefficient rehab. Conventional rehab relies on repetitive, tedious exercises, resulting in low patient adherence.
product.solution: A wearable device (surface EMG sensor + 9-axis IMU) attached to the skin measures muscle activity and joint movement in real time. Its proprietary AI digital biomarker (MFI: Muscle Function Index) quantifies muscle function. Based on the measurements, it delivers a personalized rehab program combining 40+ gamified exercise contents and automatically adjusted functional electrical stimulation (FES). A web dashboard for medical staff enables remote monitoring of patient performance and biosignal trends.

product.summary: Vertically integrated sensing stack for counter-UAS (C-UAS) airspace awareness. Composed of passive RF detection (RF AS), AI acoustic classification (Acoustic AS), compact radar (Radar AS), tower hardware integrating all three sensors (Tower AS), and proprietary C2 software (Operator AS). Provides open APIs that integrate with Anduril Lattice and Palantir Maven.
product.problem_statement: Threats from compact aerial threats such as FPV drones, reconnaissance drones, and tethered drones are endangering military facilities, airports, wildfire sites, and stadiums. Existing counter-drone platforms rely on a single sensor, creating large detection blind spots, and hardware and software are separated, leading to a slow integrated response.
product.solution: Fuses RF, radar, and acoustic into a single stack to automate detection, classification, and alerting. Processes all sensor data at the edge to deliver a single operational picture. Open APIs integrate with third-party C2 systems, allowing parallel use with existing ecosystems.

Acoustic AS: 360° acoustic classification within 1 second. No preexisting signature database required. Detects tethered drones.
Radar AS: Tracks manned and unmanned aircraft within 3km. Compact and lightweight for easy field deployment.
Tower AS: Single unit integrating radar, RF, and acoustic. More precise location tracking when operated in a network.
Operator AS: C2 UI with AI-based risk classification and real-time alerts. Integrates with Anduril Lattice and Palantir Maven.
Edge computing decodes and filters data on-site, minimizing latency and communication load.
product.tech_stack_or_innovation: AI-based acoustic classification and sensor fusion algorithms, passive RF detection with no emitted signals, edge computing, and in-house manufacturing via a 20,000 sq ft Austin factory.
